_text: [fast-paced, energetic storyteller] In this world, the more followers you have, the taller you *get*. [playful] Your mom has four-hundred. She's a perfectly normal five foot six. [excited] Kayla posted one dance video. Now she's ninety feet tall and rides the bus on the roof. [amused] And Grandpa doesn't own a phone. He's two inches tall, and rides the cat to bingo. [deadpan] You have three followers: your mom, your grandma, and a bot called... Hot-Singles-For-You. [playful] So you're four inches tall, and you get to school in your sister's lunchbox. [building excitement] And on Friday, you want to ask Zoe to prom. She's six foot, and she loves ducks. [dramatic] But so does Tyler. Tyler has two million followers. He's eight-hundred feet tall. [amused] When he sneezes, it *rains*.
